method: Translated/adapted from this project's own Russian anecdote corpus (data/anecdotes/titled.json, 1203 anecdotes). Every source anecdote was read and judged against three drop rules before translation: (1) unsafe/inappropriate for a general audience, (2) humor relies on untranslatable Russian wordplay/pun/rhyme, (3) humor requires Russian/Soviet-specific cultural or political knowledge. Anecdotes clearing all three were adapted into natural colloquial Japanese (not literal translation) with a fresh short title; nothing was invented — every kept anecdote traces to a real source row in data/anecdotes/titled.json. Some source rows bundle 2-3 unrelated jokes separated by "— — —"; each was judged independently, so a bundled row can yield 0-3 final Japanese cards.
model: Sonnet 5 (batches 1-10) + Haiku 4.5 via Workflow (remaining batches, after a Sonnet rate-limit-storm from too many concurrent raw agent calls)
